blocked_by: No creation-time minimum-ability validation exists for any casting class.
reason: It would immediately block characters the app's own creation form still lets a player build. compose_character_input takes ability scores straight from the create request, and apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/pf1_adapter.rs's own wizard_request_for fixture is Intelligence 10 -- under the rule, an Int 10 wizard could not learn a single 1st-level spell, so the seeded starter spell 'Light' (level 0 is fine) would stand but every subsequent add would refuse, and any saved Int-10 wizard would recompute as Blocked. The correct order is a creation-time guard first (refuse or warn on an Int-10 wizard), then the learn-time gate. Landing the gate alone converts a creation defect into an un-loadable character.
revisit: When character creation validates a caster's key ability against the class it is offering -- then this gate is additive rather than trapping existing saves.

blocked_by: No corpus-grounded non-caster set exists in src/rules_core/rules_tables/class_spell_levels.rs
reason: list_class_spell_levels reports one bit -- known true/false -- and that bit conflates two different facts: 'this class casts, but no list for it has been ingested' (Magus, Summoner, Oracle) and 'this class casts nothing' (Fighter, Barbarian, Rogue). Narrowing on known:false would hide legal spells from the first group; not narrowing offers illegal ones to the second. Separating them needs a corpus-grounded non-caster set in the engine, not a hardcoded class list in TypeScript -- characterHub/characterProgression.ts's CASTER_CLASSES names only the 6 full casters and would misclassify Ranger, Paladin, Inquisitor, Bloodrager and the rest as non-casters. Guessing here would trade this cycle's defect for a worse one.
revisit: When class_spell_levels grows a third state (casts-nothing vs list-not-ingested), the picker and the Known gate can both consume it and this closes for every class at once.
scope: engine: one enum + dispatch entry per class; UI: a one-line branch in buildSpellPickerOffering
